<!-- Generated by scripts/api-reference.mjs from src/data/openapi.json: do not edit, run `task refs`. -->

- `POST /api/v1/auth/wallet/requests` — Ask a wallet to sign in, or to link to the signed-in account
- `GET /api/v1/auth/wallet/requests/{request_id}` — The request, as the wallet reads it
- `POST /api/v1/auth/wallet/requests/{request_id}/response` — The wallet's answer: an `id_token` (form or JSON), or a `proof` (JSON)
- `POST /api/v1/auth/wallet/requests/{request_id}/result` — What came of a request, for the portal that asked (poll until not `pending`)
- `POST /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/identities/{identity_id}/sign` — Sign the identity's next log entry: a request for the signer's wallet (whoever signs as the tenant under its flow)

## Ask a wallet to sign in, or to link to the signed-in account

`POST /api/v1/auth/wallet/requests` · needs `Authorization: Bearer`

**Body** (`application/json`): [RequestIn](/reference/api/schemas/#requestin)

| Field | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `purpose` *(optional)* | `sign_in`, `link` | default `"sign_in"` |
| `locale` *(optional)* | `en`, `es` | default `"en"` |
| `client` *(optional)* | `portal`, `cli` | default `"portal"` |

| Status | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | [RequestOut](/reference/api/schemas/#requestout) |
| 401 | [`not_authenticated`](/reference/errors/#not_authenticated) (link) |
| 422 | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/schemas/#httpvalidationerror) — Validation Error |
| 429 | [`too_many_requests`](/reference/errors/#too_many_requests): too many sign-ins from the network address |

## What came of a request, for the portal that asked (poll until not `pending`)

`POST /api/v1/auth/wallet/requests/{request_id}/result` · needs `Authorization: Bearer`

| Parameter | In | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `request_id` | path | string (uuid) |  |

**Body** (`application/json`): [ResultIn](/reference/api/schemas/#resultin)

| Field | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `poll` | string | min length 1, max length 256 |

| Status | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | [ResultOut](/reference/api/schemas/#resultout) |
| 403 | [`wrong_poll`](/reference/errors/#wrong_poll), or another account's link |
| 404 | [`request_not_found`](/reference/errors/#request_not_found) |
| 410 | [`request_expired`](/reference/errors/#request_expired) |
| 422 | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/schemas/#httpvalidationerror) — Validation Error |

## Sign the identity's next log entry: a request for the signer's wallet (whoever signs as the tenant under its flow)

`POST /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/identities/{identity_id}/sign` · needs `Authorization: Bearer`

| Parameter | In | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `identity_id` | path | string (uuid) |  |
| `tenant_id` | path | string (uuid) |  |

**Body** (`application/json`): [LocaleIn](/reference/api/schemas/#localein)

| Field | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `locale` *(optional)* | `en`, `es` | default `"en"` |
| `client` *(optional)* | `portal`, `cli` | default `"portal"` |

| Status | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | [RequestOut](/reference/api/schemas/#requestout) |
| 403 | [`not_a_signer`](/reference/errors/#not_a_signer) |
| 404 | [`identity_not_found`](/reference/errors/#identity_not_found) |
| 409 | [`up_to_date`](/reference/errors/#up_to_date): nothing to sign; [`no_signers`](/reference/errors/#no_signers): no signer has a wallet |
| 422 | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/schemas/#httpvalidationerror) — Validation Error |
